description: Detect and execute EC shard rebalancing across the cluster

admin_config_form.title: EC Shard Balance Admin Config
admin_config_form.description: Admin-side controls for EC shard balance detection scope.

sections.title: Scope
sections.description: Optional filters applied before EC shard balance detection.

fields.name: collection_filter
fields.label: Collection Filter
fields.description: Only balance EC shards in matching collections. Comma-separated list of names, wildcards, or regex patterns.

fields.name: data_center_filter
fields.label: Data Center Filter
fields.description: Only balance within matching data centers (wildcard supported).

fields.name: disk_type
fields.label: Disk Type
fields.description: Only balance EC shards on this disk type (hdd, ssd, or empty for all).

fields.name: shard_replica_placement
fields.label: Shard Replica Placement
fields.description: EC shard replica placement constraint (e.g. 020); empty uses the master default replication (even spread only when that default is empty or zero). Mirrors the ec.balance -shardReplicaPlacement flag.

worker_config_form.title: EC Shard Balance Worker Config
worker_config_form.description: Worker-side detection thresholds and execution controls.

sections.title: Detection Thresholds
sections.description: Controls for when EC shard balance jobs should be proposed.

fields.name: imbalance_threshold
fields.label: Imbalance Threshold
fields.description: Minimum shard count imbalance ratio to trigger balancing (0.0-1.0).

fields.name: min_server_count
fields.label: Minimum Server Count
fields.description: Minimum servers required for EC shard balancing.

fields.name: io_byte_per_second
fields.label: Shard Copy IO Limit (bytes/sec)
fields.description: Limit each EC shard copy's rate in bytes per second. 0 falls back to each volume server's own maintenance rate.

fields.name: preferred_tags
fields.label: Preferred Tags
fields.description: Comma-separated disk tags to prioritize for shard placement, ordered by preference.
